answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 7 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in ember, checked in pearl, and whisper reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2586 identities would post 4028 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
